[Legit at this mode's default]

Toggle the Pyre. In boss fights an otherworldly fire dynamically strengthens the enemies, always adjusting to the maximum strength of your equipment. During the fight you can use special temporary abilities that let you manipulate the Pyre for a small price, bringing it down to a moderate threshold. One of the hardest affixes.

Pyre

In boss fights an otherworldly fire dynamically strengthens the enemies, always adjusting to the maximum strength of your equipment.
During the fight you can use special temporary abilities that let you manipulate the Pyre for a small price, bringing it down to a moderate threshold.

The Pyre is a complex mechanic for advanced players with thousands of hours in the game.
